text:
alex: Heads up — I'm proposing we add a route-level sampling flag and rename the routing header to avoid collisions with tenant metadata. Will put a short PR up today for discussion.

maria: quick Q: is this just a header rename or are we changing semantics for how sampling interacts with quota?

alex: both. plan = rename header from `X-Route` -> `X-Rd-Route` and add `route_sample` boolean in the header JSON. Sampling affects dashboard ingestion (less detail) but not quota math — quota still charged on accepted request.

sam: pinging SDK folks: this will require client libs to serialize nested route metadata differently. Python/TS/Go will need a fallback for older servers.

jessica: agree on fallback. we should add a compatibility flag in SDKs for 2 releases: accept both `X-Route` and `X-Rd-Route` and prefer the new one when present. Add a deprecation warning in logs.

alex: exactly. tentative header payload:

```
X-Rd-Route: {"route_id":"payments.v2.charge","route_sample":true,"attributes":{"env":"prod"}}
```

old header was just a string route_id. so SDKs must either keep sending the simple string or switch to JSON.

sam: can we avoid size inflation? JSON per request could be heavy for high-TP routes. maybe allow a compact token form for hot paths (route token -> server resolves metadata).

maria: we already have route tokens in the console. what's the opt-in UX for customers? if we change default to JSON, some customers will see bandwidth increases.

jessica: proposal: SDK default remains string token for hot paths. new SDK method to attach expanded metadata for non-hot flows or when customers opt into route analytics. something like: `client.attach_route_meta(...)`.

alex: that sounds reasonable. I'll sketch SDK migration helpers in the PR: a flag `enable_route_meta` that sends JSON; otherwise the client sends the token.

sam: telemetry note — ingestion pipeline needs to tag sampled requests differently so the Route Health tile in Console shows sampled vs full telemetry. We need a stable field name so metrics and logs align.

maria: are we introducing a new metric? maybe `route.sampled.count` vs `route.request.count`. ops wants both.

alex: yes. plan: emit `route.request.count` for all accepted requests, and increment `route.sampled.count` when `route_sample` is true. Console tile will surface both and a sampling ratio.

jessica: SDKs should include a small opt-in telemetry event when switching modes (string -> json) to help us track rollout adoption. `route_meta_mode: json` or `route_meta_mode: token`. keep GDPR-safe (no customer PII).

sam: SRE concern: if customers set `route_sample=true` and spam with huge metadata we could see ingestion spikes. need a server-side max size (4kb?) and to silently drop extra attributes. Also rate-limit expanded metadata.

alex: good call. I'll add header validation and 4kb limit. we'll return 400 if the token is invalid; if JSON > limit, server will strip attributes and record a warning metric.

maria: timeline? we should coordinate console tile work with SDK rollout so early adopters actually see something.

alex: timeline proposal: week 1 PR for header rename + server validation (feature flagged), week 2 SDK patches (py/ts/go) with compatibility mode, week 3 console tile behind feature flag, week 4 flip opt-in path for limited customers and start deprecation notice for old header.

jessica: SGTM. small ask: SDK teams, can you add a quick CLI check to surface the deprecation warning locally? e.g., `redwood client check-route-meta` prints current mode + upgrade hint.

sam: will do for go + ts; python can add the log-level warning on import when flag enabled.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: server/route-meta-validation feature-flag PR created (alex) — CI: pending.

alex: pushing PR now. tagging @jessica @sam for SDK review. I'll add an ADR section explaining backward compatibility plan.

maria: thanks. if anyone wants to play with the new headers before SDK patches land, you can curl with:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Rd-Route: {\"route_id\":\"payments.v2.charge\",\"route_sample\":true}" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jessica: can we also add a short note in the SDK changelogs about potential log spam during the opt-in period? small customers might panic.

sam: noted. will include migration snippet and CLI check in release notes.

alex: final ask — product/console folks: if we can wire a basic sampled ratio gauge into the Route Health tile, that will be enough for the initial rollout. we'll iterate on per-attribute telemetry later.

maria: will scope that with the console PM. thanks all :thumbsup:
